description: This is a Java source file implementing the ProductOptionService interface in a shopping system. It provides methods for listing, retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting product options associated with merchant stores.

classes.name: ProductOptionServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductOptionService for managing product options within a merchant store context, including CRUD operations and related attribute management.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product options for a given store and language.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a read-only list of product options for a store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches product options by name within a store for a specific language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product option and associated product attributes.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option by its code for a store.
